name: Tailscale
description: Tailscale distsign validates a fetched signing-key bundle against embedded Ed25519 roots and validates retrieved package signatures before finalization; the Windows path additionally verifies MSI Authenticode with the expected Tailscale Inc. certificate subject.
limitations: Newly retrieved Tailscale default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; update scheduling, installer deployment details, and historical release behavior were not independently verified.
